title: Oceanic Dense Greek Hake Stew
description: A pungent and dense one-pot Greek dish featuring hake, coconut cream, and a blend of Mediterranean spices, perfect for a hearty dinner. This stew is a pescatarian-friendly delight that combines the freshness of the ocean with the richness of coconut cream.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the hake chunks and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Pour in the coconut cream and lemon juice, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the hake is cooked through and the stew has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
